name: nginx-multisite
description: Installs and configures Nginx for three SSL-enabled static sites, including virtual hosts, redirects, security headers, compression, logging, certificates, firewall rules, and host hardening.

name: cache
description: Installs and configures Memcached and Redis caching services, including Redis authentication, logging, service enablement, runtime directories, and post-configuration cleanup.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Installs the Python and PostgreSQL runtime and deploys the FastAPI tutorial application from GitHub with a virtual environment, database configuration, environment settings, and a systemd service on port 8000.
